rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This IT Tools MCP server, developed by wrenchpilot, provides a comprehensive collection of developer utilities and tools accessible through the Model Context Protocol. It offers over 50+ tools across categories including cryptographic operations (hashing, JWT decoding, password generation), text processing (case conversion, ASCII art, Lorem Ipsum), data format conversion (JSON, XML, YAML, SQL formatting), network utilities (IP subnet calculation, URL parsing, phone formatting), mathematical operations (base conversion, temperature conversion), and encoding/decoding functions. Built with TypeScript and packaged as a Docker container for easy deployment, the server includes security features like rate limiting, input validation, and resource monitoring. It serves as a Swiss Army knife for developers, enabling AI assistants to perform common development tasks like generating secure passwords, formatting code, converting data between formats, and performing network calculations without requiring external tools or manual operations.
